attempt_history.prompt: Depict a Mavka, a Ukrainian female Soul of the Forest, as a tall beautiful ADULT woman with a round face and very long flowing hair. Fully clothed in an opaque modest flowing woodland dress. Natural humanlike anatomy, two arms and legs, no antlers, horns, wings, animal ears or exposed spine: this is the ordinary Mavka, not the no-back nyavka subtype. Standing beside a still pool in a Ukrainian mountain forest, her reflection is ABSENT from the pool while surrounding trees reflect; she casts no shadow on the ground. Her pale skin subtly glows from within and unmistakable bright green-white magical wisps and luminous motes radiate from her body and long hair among spring flowers. Haunting, enticing but nonsexual presence, no men or victims. Square premium highly detailed painterly encyclopedia illustration, one coherent mythological entity, clear silhouette fully inside frame. No text, caption, border, watermark, gore, attacks or victims.
